全新设计:
视野更开阔
内容铺满整个屏幕，顶栏与底栏化为半透明的玻璃，不再挡住内容

阅读空间更大
页面在顶部时没有多余的遮挡，浏览时底栏自动收起

来去更清楚
页面从你点按的地方展开，返回时收回原处，始终知道自己从哪里来

切换更连贯
搜索从底栏旁自然展开，进出都不打断浏览

反馈更明确
按住标签、滑块等控件时，都有清晰的反馈，操作更有把握

操作更跟手
动效跟随手指，随时可以打断；拖动返回时，可以先看一眼上一页再决定

通透度可调
玻璃的通透程度可以按喜好调整，也可以换回不透明的经典样式

图标更统一
界面图标统一为圆润的线条风格，更易辨认
帖子:
重新排版
楼层与楼中楼层次分明，阅读更舒适

长按预览
长按帖子卡片即可预览，预览过的帖子打开时无需重新加载

投票
帖子中的投票可直接查看结果并参与

语音
播放时进度沿胶囊填满，拖动即可跳转

图片
从缩略图中放大打开，长按可保存、分享等

链接
链接文字与实际地址不符时，注明实际指向

楼主管理
楼主可以删除自己帖子中的回复

点赞同步
在一处点赞，其他地方同步显示
沉浸阅读:
连载整理成正文
楼主的更新按章节整理成连贯的正文，追更更方便

阅读设置
可调整字号与字重，平板上目录常驻一侧
吧:
吧页焕新
吧页采用该吧的主题色，向上滑动时，吧头像与吧名收进顶栏

分类标签
标签悬浮在玻璃上，精品分类收进「精品」标签中

今日签到
显示该吧今天的签到人数

记住位置
每个标签各自记住浏览位置
首页与动态:
常逛的吧
关注的吧以两列显示，并附吧头像

搜索
搜索按钮位于底栏旁，也可以改为放在首页顶部

动态卡片
推荐帖子的操作收进「⋯」，一次点按即可完成

消息
回复与 @ 采用和动态一致的卡片样式
屏蔽:
长按屏蔽
在帖子或回复上长按，即可屏蔽用户、吧或关键词

更灵活的规则
条件可以组合，也可以限定生效的吧和有效期，并统计命中次数

折叠并注明原因
被屏蔽的内容会折叠起来，点按即可查看原因；搜索结果同样生效

导出与导入
屏蔽规则可以导出备份，换机后再导入

过滤低等级用户
可按等级分档设置
签到:
准时自动签到
自动签到按设定的时间进行；错过时间时，会尽快补上

实时通知
签到进度以实时通知显示

更可靠
一个吧签到失败，不影响其他吧继续签到
主题与语言:
自选主题色
任选一种颜色，自动生成整套配色，白天和夜间都协调

壁纸主题
背景柔和虚化，文字颜色随壁纸明暗自动调整；夜间同样可用

降低透明度
需要时可降低界面的透明度

英文界面
可在外观设置中切换语言
账号与隐私:
切换账号
点按底栏头像即可切换

关注与粉丝
可查看用户的关注与粉丝列表

拉黑
在用户主页即可拉黑，并可分别禁止关注、互动与私信

剪贴板
复制的链接只提示一次，尽量少读取剪贴板

备份
账号信息不再随系统云备份上传
大屏:
双栏显示
平板与折叠屏上，列表与内容左右并排

侧边栏
宽屏使用侧边导航栏，正文保持舒适的阅读宽度

A new design:
More to see
Content fills the whole screen, and the bars turn to translucent glass that no longer hides it

More room to read
Nothing covers the top of a page, and the bottom bar tucks away as you scroll

Always know where you are
Pages open out of what you tapped and close back into it

Smoother transitions
Search opens right out of the bottom bar, without breaking your browsing

Clearer feedback
Tabs, sliders and other controls respond plainly when you hold them

More responsive
Animations follow your finger and can be interrupted at any time; drag back to glance at the previous page before you go

Adjustable clarity
Set how clear the glass is, or switch back to the solid classic bars

Consistent icons
Icons share one rounded line style and are easier to recognise
Threads:
A new layout
Replies and comments are clearly set apart and easier to read

Peek
Touch and hold a thread card to preview it; a thread you peeked at opens without loading again

Polls
See results and vote right in the thread

Voice
The capsule fills as it plays; drag along it to seek

Photos
Photos open out of their thumbnails; touch and hold to save or share

Links
Links say where they really go when their text names another site

OP tools
OPs can delete replies in their own threads

Likes in sync
A like shows everywhere the post appears
Reader:
Serials as one text
An OP’s updates are arranged into chapters you read straight through

Reading settings
Adjust size and weight; on tablets, the contents stay open beside the text
Forums:
A refreshed forum page
Each forum wears its own colour, and its avatar and name move into the top bar as you scroll

Tabs
Tabs float on glass, with featured categories inside the Featured tab

Checked in today
See how many people checked in to the forum today

Your place, kept
Each tab remembers where you were
Home and feed:
Your forums
Followed forums show in two columns with their avatars

Search
The search button sits beside the bottom bar, or at the top of Home if you prefer

Feed cards
Actions on recommended threads sit behind “⋯”, each one tap away

Messages
Replies and mentions use the same cards as the feed
Hiding:
Touch and hold to hide
Hide a user, a forum or keywords right from a thread or reply

More flexible rules
Combine conditions, limit a rule to certain forums or a time, and see how often it applies

Folded with a reason
Hidden content folds away; tap it to see why. Search results are covered too

Export and import
Back up your rules and bring them to a new device

Hide low-level users
Choose the cut-off level in steps
Check-in:
On time
Automatic check-in runs at the time you set, and catches up as soon as it can if that time was missed

Live progress
Check-in progress shows as a live update

More reliable
One forum failing no longer stops the rest
Theme and language:
Your colour
Pick any colour for a full palette that works by day and by night

Wallpaper theme
The background is softly blurred, and text adapts to how light the wallpaper is, at night too

Reduce transparency
Make the interface less see-through when you need to

English
Choose the language in Appearance
Accounts and privacy:
Switch accounts
Tap your avatar on the bottom bar

Following and followers
See whom a user follows and who follows them

Block
Block a user from their profile, choosing whether they may follow, interact or message you

Clipboard
A copied link is offered once, and the clipboard is read as little as possible

Backups
Accounts are no longer uploaded with system cloud backups
Large screens:
Two panes
On tablets and foldables, lists and content sit side by side

Navigation rail
Wide windows use a side rail and keep text at a comfortable width
